description:
Read account billing and usage with status, or read the current database AI model catalog with models. Models includes supported effort and speed settings, plan availability, all token rates and sourced benchmarks. These are read-only operations; model discovery does not switch models or spend credits.

Set "action" to choose the operation. Only send the fields listed for that action.

## action="status": Get BotSpot account and billing status
No other fields required.
Returns payment status, active products, backtest usage, and current cycle limits for this authenticated MCP user.

## action="models": Get current AI models, capabilities, prices and benchmarks
No other fields required.
Read the current database catalog before choosing or recommending an AI model for chat or an AI-powered strategy. Returns exact chat ids and valid strategyModelId values, allowed reasoning efforts, Standard/Fast service tiers, plan availability, USD token prices including cache and long context, and sourced benchmark results. Empty benchmarks mean unknown; different benchmarks are not comparable. A catalog entry is advertised capability, not evidence of a successful runtime test. If runtime logs reject advertised settings, explain the observed runtime/gateway rejection and preserve the requested model/settings. Unless the error names a rejected field, do not guess one or propose changing a valid strategy identifier merely because it differs from the chat id. The useful next check is verification of that exact model, effort and service tier through the failing runtime adapter before another unchanged retry; catalog support alone does not verify a compatibility repair. This read does not run models, change a selection, start a backtest or spend credits.

action.description: Which operation to run: "status", "models". See the tool description for each one.

name: account
